Darrell, your Thor P2 (Shop····) is still being held, and I'm sorry it's taken this long.

UPS delivered your NerdOctaxe to our dock on November 6. But the warehouse still hasn't checked it in, and the Thor P2 can only ship once they have.

That's on our side, not yours. I've raised it with the team again so they push the warehouse to log the return. Someone will get back to you at (email hidden), and you'll get the Thor P2 tracking by email as soon as it ships.

Yes, that's the one, Darrell. I've got Shop···· open, so there's nothing more you need to send.

Nothing has changed in the last minute. Your Thor P2 is reserved for you at our Tennessee warehouse. It's only waiting for the warehouse to check in the NerdOctaxe that UPS delivered on November 6. I've asked the team to chase the warehouse on it.

You'll get the Thor P2 tracking by email as soon as it ships. Is there anything else on this order you wanted to ask about?
